title: PosterKit AI Import Schema
description: Fill this out from photo analysis to auto-populate a PosterKit poster. All fields are optional — omit anything the photo doesn't suggest.

layout._comment: Portrait (700×980) suits single subjects, vertical shots. Landscape (1060×700) suits wide scenes, cars, architecture.

photo._comment: Leave photoPosition and photoScale at defaults unless the subject needs reframing.

palette._comment: Extract 5 dominant colors from the photo. Order: background → midtone → pop color → highlight → near-white/near-black. Use hex strings.
palette._accentColor_hint: Pick the most vivid or emotionally resonant color from the palette. Used for the name stamp, event label, and detail labels.
palette._bgColor_hint: Match the darkest tone in the photo, or keep #0d0d0d for universal dark editorial look.

typography._comment: Choose fonts that match the mood. See available options below.

topBar._comment: The thin header line. eventLabel is the context — event name, series, location. Keep it under 60 chars.
topBar._aliasPill_hint: Short tag or handle (e.g. '@username', 'Vol.1'). Leave blank if not applicable.

subject._comment: The main subject headline. For a car: model name. For a person: name or alias. For a place: location name.
subject._subjectTitleAccentWord_hint: One word from subjectTitle to highlight in accent color. E.g. if title is 'BMW E30 316i', accentWord could be '316i'. Leave blank if no word stands out.
subject.captionText: A short atmospheric description of the photo. 1–2 sentences. Can be poetic or factual. Supports newlines with \n.

details._comment: 2-column label/value grid. 2–4 rows ideal. Use factual metadata from the photo context.

footer._comment: nameStamp is the large display-font text at the bottom — typically the photographer, brand, or subject identifier.
footer.tagline: a short memorable phrase · lowercase · separated by dots
footer._tagline_hint: Distill the photo's mood into 5–10 words. Lowercase, separated by · or —.
footer.tracklist:
tag one · tag two · tag three
mood tag · visual tag · context tag
footer._tracklist_hint: Fine-print tags like a music tracklist. 1–2 lines of dot-separated descriptors extracted from the photo's visual language — colors, textures, mood, objects.

overlays._comment: Inferred from the photo's lighting and mood.
overlays._vignetteIntensity_hint: 0 = no vignette, 1 = heavy. High-contrast dramatic photos: 0.85–0.95. Clean bright shots: 0.3–0.5.
overlays._tint_hint: If the photo has strong golden hour or colored lighting, set tintColor to match and tintOpacity 0.10–0.25. For neutral photos keep tintOpacity at 0.
